name: Milena Makwa-Sigurdsson
role: Street pharmacist and unlicensed herbalist, Oxidian Market
location: The Oxidian Market, stall row near the eastern drainage grate, Ironvein, near Western and Division
description:
Milena Makwa-Sigurdsson is a wide woman built like a river delta — slow-moving, broad, and capable of flooding without warning. Her skin is deep brown and mapped with pale vitiligo patches across her forearms and the left side of her jaw, which she has decorated with tiny bioluminescent dot tattoos that pulse gold when she's relaxed and dim to amber when she's displeased. Her hair is natural and enormous, threaded with dried flowers and small glass vials of colored tinctures she uses as hair accessories and sometimes as inventory. She wears multiple layers of padded cloth, always slightly damp-smelling from her herbal solvents, and keeps a carved wooden E.L.F. shrine nailed to the corner post of her stall where she burns data-chip offerings every morning before trading opens.

She is the market's unofficial grandmother and its most reliable source of pain management, mood stabilizers, sleep aids, and — for the right customer — things that don't have clean names. She speaks slowly and weighs every word like she's pricing it. She has strong opinions about which pharmaceutical corps are poisoning the tiers and will share them whether you asked or not. She's been in this exact stall for nineteen years and considers herself more permanent than the city grid.

core_fears: Dying before she can teach someone everything she knows
The market being demolished and her people scattered
core_desires: To be remembered as someone who kept people alive
For her daughter to come back to Ironvein
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — the morning shrine routine keeps her grounded
Productivity — when grieving she compounds medicines obsessively
blind_spots: She enables dependency in customers she likes by making their substances too affordable
She underestimates how much people exploit her soft spots
psychology.secret: Her most profitable product, a mood-leveling compound she calls 'Stillwater,' contains a trace synthetic hormone she sources from a Helix Biosystems courier who steals it from a pediatric trial. She tells herself the quantities are too small to matter. She has never fully let herself examine whether that's true.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-register Meridian slang mixed with Afrikaner-inflected clipped consonants inherited from her grandmother's side. Uses plant and weather metaphors constantly. Rarely swears; when she does it lands hard.
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate, measured, unhurried. Pauses before important sentences. Never rushes.
verbal_tics: 'You hear me?' at the end of advice
'That's not my business but—' before making it her business
Refers to the E.L.F.s as 'the ones below the signal'
example_lines: 'Stillwater's for people who've been raining inside too long. You take it right, two drops, not three. Three and you're fog.'
'I've been here since before that overpass was poured. I'll be here after it cracks. You hear me?'

story_hooks: A batch of her Stillwater has caused three customers to enter catatonic states in the same week — something upstream in her supply chain has changed, and she needs someone to find out what without implicating her.

Her estranged daughter has reappeared in the market but is buying from a rival stall and won't approach. Solveig will offer significant pharmaceutical favors to anyone who finds out what's keeping her daughter away.
narrative_function: Quest giver (knows who needs what and who can't afford it legally), information source on market politics and street health crises, moral compass figure who dispenses wisdom alongside questionable pharmaceuticals, local color anchor for the Oxidian Market.
augmentations: Bioluminescent dot tattoos (cosmetic, Helix Biosystems dye-work). Reinforced knee joints — basic medical-grade, installed after a street collapse injury. No geneware.
daily_life: Arrives before dawn to arrange her stock and burn morning offerings to the moisture E.L.F. she believes protects her tinctures from spoilage. Trades through daylight hours, closes before the second-shift crowd turns rowdy, and spends evenings compounding new batches in a back-room she rents above a pipe-fitter's workshop.
affiliation: The Oxidian Market Vendors Guild (senior member), independent

decision_rules: Never sell to anyone who looks younger than fifteen, no exceptions
Always maintain the morning ritual even when sick or grieving
Don't extend credit past three weeks — compassion has limits
escalation_ladder: Public shaming — she has a loud voice and knows everyone in earshot
Refusing to sell to that person ever again

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful and neutral. Gives them one chance to show what they're made of before deciding whether to bother.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fierce, generous, opinionated. Will push her medicine on you whether you asked or not.

stress_responses.low: Tidies her stall, re-labels jars that don't need re-labeling
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and watchful, stops volunteering information
stress_responses.high: Sends everyone away, locks her stall, sits with her shrine until she can breathe again

contradictions: Preaches self-sufficiency but has deep codependent bonds with her regulars
Distrusts corps completely but her best product relies on stolen corp materials
habits: Burns a data chip at her shrine every morning — usually old music files
Keeps dried lemon grass behind her ear as a personal scent marker
Tastes every new compound batch herself before selling, no matter how small the dose
breaking_points: Someone harming a child in her market will make her abandon all de-escalation instincts
Threat to demolish the Oxidian Market triggers genuine rage

timeline.event: 2139 — Born in Ironvein to a Mbeki-Castaño family of market traders
2157 — Apprenticed to an unlicensed chemist who operated three stalls over from her current position
2164 — Knee injury during the Ironvein pipe collapse; first aug installed
2170 — Established her own stall, began developing her own compound lines
2181 — Daughter Amara born; father unknown and never discussed
2194 — Daughter Amara leaves Ironvein without explanation
2199 — Promoted to senior member of the Vendors Guild after the previous elder retired

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend anchored by Eastern European (31.2%) and Northern European (28.5%) ancestry, substantially enhanced by Pacific Islander (15.2%) and Indigenous American (13.6%) heritage, with meaningful South Asian (5.9%) and Sub-Saharan African (5.6%) contributions. This creates a phenotype of remarkable balance: Pacific Islander robustness and facial fullness in the midface and cheeks, Northern European bone definition and eye shape, Eastern European facial angularity in cheekbones and jawline, warmth and depth from South Asian and African ancestry throughout. The overall effect is a weathered, capable appearance — built for endurance and presence, with features that speak to multiple continents and centuries of movement.
physical_description.build: Wide-set and broad-shouldered with substantial mass distributed across her frame like sediment — sturdy rather than soft, built for endurance and presence rather than speed
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with silver threading
physical_description.hair_style: Voluminous, naturally textured, intricately braided and threaded throughout with dried flower stems, small glass vials of colored tinctures, and beaded sections
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep golden-brown with complex undertones reflecting the Pacific Islander, Northern European, Eastern European, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African blend. The base carries the depth of African and South Asian lineage while the golden warmth speaks to Pacific Islander and Northern European heritage. Extensive pale vitiligo patches across both forearms and left jaw line create striking high-contrast maps against the rich base tone.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but well-maintained, minimal makeup. Strong cheekbone definition showing Eastern European angularity balanced with Pacific Islander fullness and a subtle South Asian softness in the overall contours. Eye shape reflects Northern European ancestry with warm, observant quality from other lineages. The vitiligo patches are her most striking feature — unpigmented but not treated or hidden; they create a natural geography across her skin. Fine lines around her eyes suggest decades of focused work and market assessment. Facial structure demonstrates a sophisticated blend: broader through the middle face and cheeks (Pacific Islander heritage), with defined cheekbones and a strong jaw line (Eastern European and Northern European), and an overall warmth in tone and feature softness (South Asian and African heritage contributions).
distinguishing_marks: Vitiligo patches mapped across forearms in irregular continents of pale skin
Vitiligo stripe along the left jawline from cheekbone to chin
Bioluminescent dot tattoos scattered across the vitiligo patches on her jaw and forearms — tiny golden pinpricks that pulse gently with her emotional state, dimming to amber when displeased
Thin scar running along her right knee from medical-grade joint reinforcement surgery, visible when she moves
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Reinforced knee joints (surgical scars visible, slight metallic sheen under skin at joint line when she moves; slight stiffness in cold). Bioluminescent tattoo dye (Helix Biosystems biotech, visible as glowing dots across jaw and forearms, color-responsive to mood).
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves deliberately and economically, weight forward on the balls of her feet despite her size — the movement pattern of someone who has spent sixty years standing in markets. Her gait is steady but shows slight favoring of her left side due to reinforced knee. She leans on her stall counter frequently, not from exhaustion but from the ease of someone who owns her workspace. Her hands move with precision when handling vials and compounds.
physical_description.clothing_style: Multiple layers of damp-smelling padded cloth in muted tones — grays, browns, deep greens — all showing the wear and staining of nineteen years of herbal work. Aprons with deep pockets, some with small vials sewn into the lining. Worn wool shawl wrapped and rewrapped throughout the day. No corpo branding or tier-status markers; her clothes are purely functional, Tier 4-5 working class, but meticulously organized and maintained. Wears carved wooden jewelry — simple E.L.F. shrine charms and beaded bracelets.
